bound.walk: copy printed untemplated collection GET paths from the official Artsdatabanken NiN Kode API OpenAPI paths object; native ids are those printed paths without a leading slash; access_path is the printed path joined to the OpenAPI origin; skip templated {kortkode} paths; do not invent endpoint ids
bound.how: pda ingest --source nin --limit 10. The official Artsdatabanken NiN Kode API OpenAPI prints 16 GET paths, of which 6 are untemplated collection paths. The adapter copies those 6 printed paths and joins each to the OpenAPI origin. GET uses the printed path with no invented query filters.
